calendar_target_2017_native_scope.classification: Retained source-set comparison against current installed package; candidate scope for source-year review, not an approved native reassignment.
calendar_target_2017_native_scope.interpretation: 2016-17 retained schedule/preallocation sources produce 41 clubs with first league fixtures dated in calendar 2017 (provider season ID 2016). The current 2017-18 package is built from provider season ID 2017: it has 39 country-club rows, 27 stable TM club IDs overlap, 14 calendar-target IDs are absent and 12 current-plan IDs are absent from the target set. Candidate current carrier rows were mapped through each revision carrier-allocation and current package carrier IDs. These assignment files use canonical source ordering and do not establish that the candidate mapping is approved. Source and native labels differ across 25 carrier entries; that is a review scope, not a confirmed count of wrong game clubs or players.
calendar_target_2017_native_scope.raw_source_note: For all 41 calendar-2017 rows, cached schedule and report HTML bodies exist. The preallocation player rows and original squad source URL/SHA are retained and source SHA matches the snapshot metadata; raw squad HTML body files were not found in the revision/plan cache roots checked. For 39 current-plan rows, schedule/report cache bodies and squad-source snapshot bindings likewise exist.

finding.ambiguous_exception: Russia 2010-11 has source title 10/11 and first fixture in 2011 (7 rows); retain as transition ambiguity pending explicit mapping. Russia 2000-2009 contributes 65 rows whose first fixtures are the following calendar year despite 00/01…09/10 schedule titles; classify them under pre-2011 calendar mapping review.
finding.implication: Treat as a confirmed source-plan mapping gap and likely next-calendar-year routing error in retained selected rows. Do not select a corrected provider year mechanically from this report; establish the intended country mapping and inspect its source schedule/roster before rebasing. This is not a count of native defects or proven wrong players. Paired same-club retained schedules for Brazil/Ireland/Norway/Sweden show provider season ID Y-1 yields the recorded first fixture in calendar year Y, while provider ID Y yields the following year; this supports a candidate Y-1 mapping for those four 2017 examples, but is not a complete all-years/country policy declaration.
finding.observed: For each available source plan, the capture plan passes the same start_year for every country; Brazil, Ireland, Norway and Sweden first domestic fixture dates in all selected rows are start_year+1. Russia rows for 2000-2010 also show start_year+1, but the 2010/11 source season is separately marked transitional/ambiguous. The current capture therefore has no declared per-country source-year mapping and retained calendar-league results come from the next calendar year relative to each plan start year.
